name: @contextcake/core
description: The ContextCake cascade engine: sources, resolver, search, MCP server, and write path. Node built-ins only.
//: Deliberately not an npm workspace. Declaring workspaces here would force an `npm install` at the repo root, and the engine's defining constraint is that it runs on plain Node with no root install. Consumers (apps/desktop, the root CLI shims, tests) import by relative path; this file exists to give the directory a real identity, pin the module type locally, and document the public surface below.
